neighbours.label: retinoid / vitamin A context: the tokens right after a retinoid or vitamin A is named (tretinoin, isotretinoin, retinoids, vitamin A), also skin-treatment lists where a retinoid is the expected next word
fire: For stubborn acne, many doctors start with tretinoin, a cream that speeds up skin cell turnover.
Pregnant women should avoid isotretinoin (sold under several brand names) because it causes birth defects.
Deficiency of vitamin A (common in parts of Africa and Asia) can lead to night blindness.
Sunscreen should be worn daily by anyone using retinoids, since these drugs make skin more sensitive.
The cream contains adapalene, a newer retinoid that tends to irritate the skin less.
Liver is extremely rich in vitamin A, or retinol, and should be eaten only in moderation.
Fine lines often respond well to prescription retinoids, glycolic acid and daily sun protection.
Her dermatologist switched her from tretinoin (which made her skin peel) to a gentler lotion.
quiet: For stubborn heartburn, many doctors start with omeprazole, a pill that reduces stomach acid production.
Pregnant women should avoid warfarin (sold under several brand names) because it causes birth defects.
Deficiency of vitamin D (common in northern countries in winter) can lead to weak bones.
A helmet should be worn daily by anyone using scooters, since these vehicles offer little protection.
The tablet contains loratadine, a newer antihistamine that tends to cause less drowsiness.
Citrus fruit is extremely rich in vitamin C, or ascorbic acid, and can be eaten freely.
Sore throats often respond well to salt water gargles, warm tea and plenty of rest.
Her cardiologist switched her from atenolol (which made her feel tired) to a different pill.

notes: probe: fires just after retinoid names and on ' ret'; also on 'treated with ... or' in acne/eczema treatment lists (retinoid expected). Near misses are other vitamins and non-skin drugs.
